mapper.select: SELECT id, enabled, provider, base_url, api_key, model, temperature, max_tokens, timeout_seconds, stream_tool_turns, stream_answer_turns, updated_at FROM llm_settings WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_settings ( id, enabled, provider, base_url, api_key, model, temperature, max_tokens, timeout_seconds, native_tool_calls_only, stream_tool_turns, stream_answer_turns ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{enabled}, #{provider}, #{baseUrl}, #{apiKey}, #{model}, #{temperature}, #{maxTokens}, #{timeoutSeconds}, 1, #{streamToolTurns}, #{streamAnswerTurns} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), provider = VALUES(provider), base_url = VALUES(base_url), api_key = VALUES(api_key), model = VALUES(model), temperature = VALUES(temperature), max_tokens = VALUES(max_tokens), timeout_seconds = VALUES(timeout_seconds), native_tool_calls_only = 1, stream_tool_turns = VALUES(stream_tool_turns), stream_answer_turns = VALUES(stream_answer_turns), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
